name: Sammy Christen

papers.title: Walk Like This: Stylized Locomotion for Physics-Based Characters through Example-Driven Diffusion
papers.abstract:
We present a real-time framework for expressive legged locomotion that enables independent control over velocity and style. 
Unlike existing data-driven controllers which typically require explicit style labels for training, our method efficiently leverages large-scale unstructured motion data, enabling generalization to unseen styles. We disentangle style from functional locomotion through a tailored sampling strategy used to train a style encoder, which is fed to an autoregressive diffusion model. During inference, the user provides a style reference clip and a joystick velocity command. The diffusion model then generates a kinematic reference tracked by a reinforcement learning controller. To improve user controllability and stylization strength, we propose an attention-biasing mechanism and a velocity command correction strategy. We demonstrate our method on a physics-based humanoid character in simulation and on a physical robot, showcasing robust real-time control and continuous style modulation.
